title: Vehicle Age, Mileage and APR Adjustments for Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
Pre-owned contracts finance used vehicles sold by Kestrel dealers, of any make. Under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract the vehicle itself must qualify, and its make and certification set the final contract rate.

**Vehicle limits.** The vehicle's age, the contract year minus the model year, must not exceed the maximum vehicle age and the odometer reading at contract must not exceed the maximum odometer for the tier. Both are read from the contract's own vehicle record.

**Rate adjustment.** The contract APR starts from the tier's rate sheet; for a Kestrel Certified Pre-Owned vehicle the Certified Pre-Owned APR reduction is subtracted, and for a vehicle that is not a Kestrel make the non-Kestrel make APR adder is added; the two adjustments never apply together because certification is available only on Kestrel makes. The adjusted APR is the rate disclosed on the contract and is never changed after booking.

### Rate outcomes

| Vehicle | Contract APR |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Certified Pre-Owned | rate-sheet APR less the reduction for the tier |
| Kestrel make, not certified | rate-sheet APR |
| Another make | rate-sheet APR plus the adder for the tier |

### Hypothetical checks

- A contract written in a given year on a vehicle whose model year is eight years earlier has a vehicle age of 8. On a tier whose maximum vehicle age is 8 the vehicle qualifies; on a tier whose maximum is 7 it does not.
- An odometer reading exactly equal to the tier maximum does not exceed it and qualifies; one mile more does not.
- With an illustrative rate-sheet APR of 9.00 percent and a reduction of 0.75 points, a Kestrel Certified Pre-Owned vehicle is disclosed at 8.25 percent, and that rate stays on the contract for its life.
